newsitem.title: USA: Baker, Fentress & Co Q4 net asset value up.
newsitem.headline: Baker, Fentress & Co Q4 net asset value up.

text.p: Baker, Fentress & Co said Wednesday its net asset value as of December 30 rose to $21.77 from $21.75 in the same period one year ago.
Total net assets as of December 30 rose to $741.1 million from $599.2 million in 1995. Average shares outstanding were 34 million, versus 27.5 million.

For the 12 months that ended December 30, net investment income reached $10.7 million, or $0.31 per share. For the corresponding period in 1995, net investment income totaled $9.4 million, or $0.34 per share.
Baker, Fentress is an investment company. Its shares were unchanged Wednesday at 17-3/4.
